design: Four tasks x4content pairs x4contexts. Train if(context+content)%2==0, reserve opposite parity. Every factor appears separately in training; each reserved combination is absent.
gate: Per family/split require all8aligned token-valid pairs, >=75%both-endpoint binary accuracy and>=50%semantic/exact top1. Training eligibility determined solely by train; heldout competence reported separately.
scope: Recombination of lexical content and nuisance/framing contexts, not composition of distinct computational primitives or unseen-task discovery. Semantic contrasts are task-specific and explicitly recorded.
controls: Zero residual edit transfers exact donor token-content while keeping recipient residual; full boundary transplant checks target replay. Native model errors retained. No representation fitted.
